floor_menu.name: Floor circuit (~12 min)
floor_menu.detail: 3 rounds: 10 push-ups, 15 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges, 30 s plank

push.gym: +1 set on up to 2 upper-body exercises, or the arm/shoulder finisher (2 × lateral raise, curl, triceps, 12–20 reps). Never extra leg sets.
push.run: 4–6 × 20 s strides at the end (fast but relaxed, walk back to recover)
